setting.description: Introductory text for Step 4 - Corresponding author section.

value.default:
Please select the person in charge of handling the correspondence with the Journal and indicate the country of their affiliation exactly as stated in the manuscript file.

If the corresponding author is affiliated with more than one institution in different countries (as indicated in the manuscript), please select a country that has a Transformative Agreement in place with the journal’s publisher, IOP Publishing.: https://publishingsupport.iopscience.iop.org/questions/institutional-open-access-agreements/.

NB: authors can be selected as corresponding authors only if they have required information in their personal profile: name, email, affiliation, country and Orcid id.

Manuscript file: accepted formats are tex, tar.gz and zip. Source files will be converted to pdf.

ESM: additional material that you are submitting for publication along with the manuscript file. Authors take full responsibility for their content and they will not be transformed in any way during the production stage.

Administrative files: any file that you wish to send the Journal for administrative purposes. They will neither be reviewed nor published.
